blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **порядочный** — поря́дочный: decent, honest, respectable; (figurative) decent, sizable, considerable; (colloquial) utter, out-and-out. Wiktionary: поря́док + -ный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **ручно́й** — (relational) hand; manual. Source: Wiktionary, «-ной» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ной#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**ручная** — ручно́й: (relational) hand; manual; handmade; tame, domesticated. Wiktionary: рука́ + -но́й.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **выходно́й** — (relational) exit. Source: Wiktionary, «-ной» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ной#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**выходной** — выходно́й: (relational) exit; (relational) holiday, day off; festive; free (not working), on a day off, off; (relational) discharge; given on discharge. Wiktionary: вы́ход + -но́й.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: (also, figuratively) Russian, related to Russian ethnicity, language, or culture
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ру́сский — (also, figuratively) Russian, related to Russian ethnicity, language, or culture; геро́йский — heroic; а́вторский — author's; ца́рский — czarist, imperial, of the czar.
**входно́й** — (relational) entrance. Source: Wiktionary, «-ной» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ной#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **записно́й** — (relational) note; intended for notes. Source: Wiktionary, «-ной» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ной#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**записную** — записно́й: (relational) note; intended for notes; (colloquial) inveterate, out-and-out. Wiktionary: за́пись + -но́й.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **резно́й** — cut, carved. Source: Wiktionary, «-ной» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ной#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
